about: Every poll in Wikipedia's polling tables for the 2015-03-17 election, from the day after the previous election (2013-01-22) to the day before the vote, newest first: 174 polls by 27 pollsters (0 by Shlomo Filber's firms). The outgoing Knesset was dissolved on 2014-12-08 (108 polls since). Same schema as the 28-day files in data/, with the same lists, blocs, agreements and result as data/2015-03.json; parties that merged, split or withdrew during the campaign have their own ids, listed in otherLists (`into` names the final list they merged into). Built by scripts/forecast/backtest/build-data-full.py; memo docs/research/polls-method/round2/D1-data-full.md.
blocNote: Netanyahu bloc as calibration.json counts it for 2015: Likud, Jewish Home, Shas, UTJ, Yisrael Beiteinu, Yachad. Kulanu (centrist, joined the government after the vote) is 'mid'.
